tagline: AI systems that can do the work, show the work, and prove the work.
tagline_developer: The platform for governed agentic work.
positioning: AI Done Right builds the open registries and governed runtime layers behind trustworthy AI agents. Baltor governs what agents know. Teleon governs what agents do. The Open*Hubs make context, skills, tools, endpoints, environments, sandboxes, benchmarks, harnesses, receipts and state discoverable — without making discovery equal trust.
mission: Most AI systems fail because they treat output as truth, discovery as trust, and tool access as capability. AI Done Right builds the missing infrastructure: governed context, deterministic capabilities, model-routing receipts, sandboxed agents, benchmarks, harnesses, and open registries that make agentic work safer, cheaper, and more provable.
